author: aadi
note: Approved by Aadi as known-good (2026-09-29: "approved good idea, it is sensible"). A taste of an existing paid benefit (Advanced reasoning mode, 3 answers today). Replaces kg-run-luzia-c03, whose 5-character premise rests on what the real Luzia model lists as an open question.

candidate.title: Existing opportunity: Welcome-back card: try Advanced reasoning mode for 3 answers
candidate.what_is_different_here: The Luzia+ paywall (s02) lists 'Advanced reasoning mode' (s02.e03) as a paid feature. A returning free user sees a one-day, 3-answer sample of it on the Chats home (s01), under the existing Luzia+ badge (s01.e02). The full feature stays behind the Weekly / Monthly / Annual plans and the 3-day trial (s02.e19).
candidate.trigger_event: First app open after 3 or more days with no session, by a user without Luzia+.
candidate.placement: A dismissible card under the Chats header, above the 'How can I help you today?' prompt card.
candidate.offer_copy: Welcome back! Play a short game to get 3 answers in Advanced reasoning mode today, Luzia+'s deeper-thinking mode.
candidate.frequency_cap: 1 per day, resets at midnight local time; shown only on the first open after a 3+ day gap
candidate.decline_path: Tapping 'Not now' closes the card. Home works exactly as before, and the card does not return until the user's next gap of 3+ days.
candidate.ad_fail_path: If no game is available, the card is not shown. If the play isn't confirmed, a note says 'That game didn't count, try again'. The card stays and the day's offer is not used up.
candidate.subscriber_treatment: Never shown. Luzia+ members already have Advanced reasoning mode.
candidate.advertiser_category: Casual mobile games, streaming services, language and learning apps
candidate.character_use: Luzia's own avatar appears on the card, inviting the user back.

flow_steps.caption: A user who hasn't opened Luzia in 3+ days lands on Chats as usual.
A welcome-back card offers 3 answers in Advanced reasoning mode for a short game.
The user plays a short sponsored game and can close it at any time.
The card changes to '3 Advanced reasoning answers ready today. Start a chat.'

candidate.after_reward: When the 3 answers are used or the day ends, a small note on Chats says Luzia+ keeps Advanced reasoning mode on every day and shows the 3-day free trial button. The user has just felt what they would be paying for.
candidate.rationale: A lapsing user needs a reason to ask Luzia something today. A day's sample of a paid feature they haven't tried is a fresh reason, and it doubles as a preview of Luzia+. Each answer uses real model time, so it pays for itself in higher-earning markets like North America. In lower-earning markets it should drop to 1 answer or need a second game.

economics.assumption_line: Costs ~$0.0063 per reward to serve; pays for itself above $6.30 eCPM at 2k context ($10.80 at 8k). It is a sample of the paid benefit l02 "Advanced reasoning mode", which stays on sale. A rewarded view earns $9.20-16.49 eCPM in North America on Android, $1.90 in LATAM. Assumes 3 replies of 800 tokens out, at $0.25 / $2.00 per million tokens in / out (central prices); the verdict uses the 8k figure; one view per reward; a publisher-net eCPM (share 1).
